name: 19041-logitbias-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Dense LlamaForCausalLM: 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16. Read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 64, warmup the first 10% by completed requests, bounded at 1024 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no tools: prompt EXACTLY 1024 tokens and output EXACTLY 256 (min = max, ignore_eos), and the same 100-entry logit_bias on every request -- 100 token ids at +1.0, written out literally in scenario.json as spec.backend.sampling_params.logit_bias.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant with word-preference controls, serving 64 concurrent users 1024-token prompts and 256-token replies on one GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
